summary: The easy family permits a perfect shortcut: always choose e^x for the integrating-factor field. Five affected stored questions were reproduced. Other checks passed within the tested scope; the package remained unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Solve first-order linear initial value problems using integrating factors.
reasoning_steps: Apply the initial condition and select the particular solution.
invariants: The solution satisfies both the ODE and initial condition.
Normal practice has two unambiguous select fields.
permitted_variations: Vary small coefficients and initial values while recomputing dependent content.
Vary correct expressions and choice positions without changing the method.

source_replay.details: All nine source prompts and 80 choices replay mathematically. Missing source evidence and duplicate source choices are documented.

math.details: Exact differentiation and initial-condition checks passed for fresh samples, runner records, controlled cases, and all 66 current easy tasks.

variety.details: Initial values and particular solutions vary, but every easy integrating-factor answer is e^x. An eligible coefficient change is rejected.

scope.details: Sampled questions preserve the source method, reasoning stages, and select response contract.

grading.details: Native grader: 163 accepted and 322 rejected checks, with no mismatches or unresolved cases.

rendering.details: Eleven actual-UI renders passed; eight screenshots were visually inspected, including controlled pairs.

packaging.details: Declared versions match runtime. Deterministic replay and relocated CLI execution pass. All 118 package files remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Choosing e^x succeeds on all 66 easy tasks, all 17 accepted fresh records, and all 3 accepted runner records. Five stored easy questions reproduce the weakness.

findings.description: easy_constant fixes P=1, making “choose e^x” a perfect first-field strategy without inspecting the equation. Choice shuffling and delivery filtering preserve the shortcut.
findings.reproduction: Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python regression.py from evidence_root. It exits 1: easy seed=991, parameters a=2,b=2,h=-1 raises 'Easy fixes unit P'. Expected I=e^(2x) and y=2-3e^(-2x). The a=1 counterpart generates successfully.
findings.requested_change: Allow small constant coefficients to change the integrating-factor answer while preserving easy workload. Derive the prompt, banks, solution, and key together. Retain the strict coefficient-change regression and rerun shortcut checks after delivery filtering.
